Third-party notices for test/vendor/just-bash-3.6.0/index.cjs (a test-only copy; not in any package).

index.cjs is just-bash 3.6.0's dist/bundle/index.cjs, unchanged: just-bash, Copyright 2025 Vercel Inc.,
Apache-2.0 (LICENSE beside this file). It inlines the npm packages below; their versions are those
just-bash 3.6.0's dependency ranges resolve to on Oct 24 2026 (the bundle doesn't record the exact ones),
and each license text is from that version's npm tarball. The packages it requires instead of inlining
(diff, guarded-fetch, run, seek-bzip, sprintf-js, sql.js, turndown, @mongodb-js/zstd, node-liblzma) are
not vendored, and the oracle cases don't reach them.
